model.status: Provisional, Non-Forecast, Not Investment-Grade, Not Contract-Grade

dashboardMetrics: Consolidated Core Contribution Before Blocked Items
Rural Bank Contribution Before Internal Bank Payroll-Support Cost
scenarioComparisonRules: Conservative, Base, and Accelerated must remain coherent operating states.
Scenario tables consume workbook outputs rather than recalculating independent numbers.
Blocked return metrics remain blocked in scenario comparison.
Core Payroll and optional SMS remain separated.
dashboardRules: Dashboard values must link to model output sheets.
Dashboard must display the controlled-placeholder warning.
Dashboard must display stakeholder revenue non-additivity warning.
Dashboard must display ERROR count and blocked-input count.
Dashboard must not add entity-level stakeholder revenues into external revenue.
sourceLineageRules: Every material workbook output must map to a source document.
Every numeric input must map to a canonical assumption ID or provisional input ID.
Every blocked output must identify the blocking assumption or dependency.
The workbook must never be listed as the commercial source of truth.
Decision records must be cited for economic treatment and revenue split decisions.
requiredChecks: Scenario selector points to a valid scenario
Consolidated external revenue counts external inflows once
Core Payroll and optional SMS remain separated
Source lineage covers every material output
No source-lineage row uses workbook as source of truth
No unsupported values are introduced in presentation sheets
runtimeChecks: Build or open Slice 5 workbook first
Add Slice 6 scenario, dashboard, checks, and source-lineage sheets
Confirm dashboard formulas link to workbook outputs
Confirm source-lineage table covers material outputs
Render dashboard, scenarios, checks, and source-lineage sheets for visual QA
